يحتكروا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَكِرُوا (yaḥtakirū) /jaħ.ta.ki.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
# يُحْتَكَرُوا (yuḥtakarū) /juħ.ta.ka.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَكَرَ (iḥtakara)
